content.comment_body: Hello, Is there any way to bypass the mandatory login/password requirement when using unencrypted TCP connections? Our relay server can't be set up with inbound authentication because many other network devices send emails and cannot be changed to use authentication. Thanks,

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a challenge with the email settings of a [product_name] module, where login/password authentication is required for unencrypted SMTP connections. This limitation makes it difficult to integrate with existing networks that use SMTP relays without authentication, highlighting a conflict between the product's security approach and practical legacy network environments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to use the product for SMTP email relay on unencrypted connections without mandatory authentication, so it remains compatible with their current infrastructure.
